thread.content: https://cs182-special-participation-d-red-team1.vercel.app/Group Members: Alex Luu, Krish YadavWe used Gemini 3.0 and Sonnet 4.5 to vibe code this site. In the first phase, we used an LLM to generate a Python script that interfaces with EdStem's API through the edapi package. It extracts titles, parses XML-formatted content, separates file attachments from external links, and automatically generates relevant tags based on keywords like homework numbers and technical terms. All extracted data is structured and exported to a JSON file. In the second phase, a new LLM session consumed the structured JSON data to build the complete web interface. This displays the posts in cards and also links back to the relevant EdStem posts. The site allows the user to filter by the generated tags.

https://cs182-special-participation-d-red-team1.vercel.app/

Group Members: Alex Luu, Krish Yadav

We used Gemini 3.0 and Sonnet 4.5 to vibe code this site. In the first phase, we used an LLM to generate a Python script that interfaces with EdStem's API through the edapi package. It extracts titles, parses XML-formatted content, separates file attachments from external links, and automatically generates relevant tags based on keywords like homework numbers and technical terms. All extracted data is structured and exported to a JSON file. In the second phase, a new LLM session consumed the structured JSON data to build the complete web interface. This displays the posts in cards and also links back to the relevant EdStem posts. The site allows the user to filter by the generated tags.
